0x33's Aviators: 0x33's Aviators are a vanity item obtained by defeating the Eye of Cthulhu in Master Mode.
Aaron's set: Aaron's set are vanity developer items that can be obtained rarely (6.25% chance) from Treasure Bags dropped from Hardmode bosses (except Queen Slime's). They are acquired simultaneously. They are the set made for AaronC, an artist who formerly developed graphics for Terraria. Equipping the full set produces a glow effect similar to Spooky armor and grants an after-image movement effect similar to Ninja armor.
Unlike the other developer sets, Aaron's does not include wings. These items are to be equipped in the Social Slots as they only provide a visual appearance.
Abeemination: The Abeemination is a boss-summoning item that summons the Queen Bee when used. It can only be used in the Jungle or Underground Jungle, at any time.
Abigail's Flower: Abigail's Flower is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons the Abigail minion. She floats towards enemies and inflicts continuous contact damage, as well as pausing to emit damaging flashes of light.

When Abigail's Flower is used more than once, multiple Abigails do not spawn; instead, the existing Abigail becomes stronger and faster for each additional summon. Abigail has a visual indicator for the number of times she is summoned, with the flower on her head changing shape and hue for each stage. In Hardmode, the boost from multiple summons is much greater.
Abigail's Flower can be uncommonly found as a plant growing on grass near a placed Tombstone, regardless of world progression. It spawns more frequently in The Constant and Zenith worlds.
Acid Dye: Acid Dye is a dye acquired as a random reward from the Dye Trader for giving him a Strange Plant. When equipped in the dye slot, it applies a dark green rippling effect that pulses outward, similar to Blue Acid Dye and Red Acid Dye. Items dyed by it can be seen in the dark but do not emit light.
Acorn: The Acorn is a type of seed used to plant trees. Acorns can be planted on regular green grass, Hallowed grass, Corrupt grass, Crimson grass, Jungle grass, Sand, or Snow, where they will create saplings that will grow into trees, under the right conditions. Acorns are randomly dropped when cutting down or shaking trees and can also be purchased from the Dryad for 10 Copper each.
Acorns cannot be retrieved after being placed. Destroying the sapling will not yield any items.
Trees grown from Acorns will be much shorter than ones naturally generated at world creation. This can be circumvented by Infused Fertilizer.
Acorns can be used as ammunition for the Acorn Slingshot.
Acorn Slingshot: The Acorn Slingshot is a weapon that uses Acorns as ammo. It fires arcing acorns that plant themselves upon landing on a suitable soil block for a tree, but otherwise bounce and roll on blocks. If acorns reach a low enough speed without finding suitable soil or collide with an enemy, they will get destroyed and drop as items.
The Acorn Slingshot has a 1/3 (33.33%) to be found as secondary loot in Living Wood Chests, and can be rarely obtained by shaking Forest, Boreal, Pearlwood and Ash trees.
Active Stone Block: The Active Stone Block and Inactive Stone Block are blocks that act as mechanisms. A given pair behave as a single block whose presence can be switched "on" or "off" using wire and a trigger. When triggered, an Active Stone Block becomes an Inactive Stone Block, and vice versa. Wires must pass through all Active/Inactive Stone Blocks that are to be triggered.

An Active Stone Block is a foreground object. This means it looks and behaves as an ordinary Stone Block, inhibits movement, allows entities to stand or walk on it, blocks light, and can stop liquids.

An Inactive Stone Block is a background object. While still visible, it looks like darker Stone Block, and behaves like furniture. It is essentially empty space, allowing the passage of players, items, liquids, light, etc.

Inactive Stone Blocks cannot be placed next to each other without the support of other adjacent foreground blocks. Active blocks do not have this shortcoming, and switching them to Inactive afterwards using wires will still have the same outcome.
Actuation Rod: The Actuation Rod is a post-Skeletron, craftable tool which allows directly switching the states of Actuators without having to activate them via wire. It is compatible with Smart cursor.
Actuator: The Actuator is a mechanism item purchased from the Mechanic for 10 Silver each, or harvested from sand traps, lava traps, boulder traps, or Dead Man's Chest traps. It has to be placed on a tile and connected with wiring to function. When activated, the tile it is on toggles between active and inactive state, effectively allowing any block to be toggled like Active or Inactive Stone Blocks. Like Wire, Actuators are normally invisible and only become visible when a mechanism item is held.
The following items interact with Actuators:
They can be placed with The Grand Design (though they can also be placed by hand).
They can be removed with the Wire Cutter or The Grand Design.
The Presserator automatically places Actuators on objects when placing them, if the player has any.
The Actuation Rod can toggle any Actuator within a limited range without requiring Wire.
Adamantite Bar: The Adamantite Bar is a Hardmode bar.
Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanium Bar.
Adamantite Beam: The Adamantite Beam is a Hardmode brick. Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanstone Block.
Adamantite Beam Wall: Adamantite Beam Wall is a type of wall crafted from Adamantite Beam.
Adamantite Chainsaw: The Adamantite Chainsaw is a Hardmode chainsaw and the alternative to the Adamantite Waraxe.
Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanium Chainsaw.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.
Adamantite Drill: The Adamantite Drill is a Hardmode drill. It is the alternative to the Adamantite Pickaxe, having a higher base mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.
Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanium Drill. The Adamantite Drill has slightly less pickaxe power and damage.
(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.

(Old-gen console and 3DS versions) Its best modifier is Demonic, as it does not have any knockback and thus cannot get modifiers that affect it, and furthermore cannot get modifiers that affect its speed, either.
Adamantite Glaive: The Adamantite Glaive is a Hardmode spear.
Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanium Trident.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.
Adamantite Ore: Adamantite Ore belongs to the third tier of the early Hardmode ores. Upon the third altar broken, either it or Titanium Ore can spawn in the cavern layer, roughly at lava depth. Mining Adamantite Ore requires a Mythril/Orichalcum Pickaxe or better.

As with all early Hardmode ores, decreasing quantities of the ore spawn with every third altar broken afterwards, it is immune to explosives (apart from the Power Bomb and Sticky Power Bomb), and it can be obtained from Hardmode crates.
It is one of the two ores able to create Hardmode Forges, which are used for smelting all ores obtained in future progression, as well as itself.
Adamantite Pickaxe: The Adamantite Pickaxe is a Hardmode pickaxe. It is the alternative to the Adamantite Drill, having a lower base mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. It can mine blocks up to Adamantite and Titanium Ore.
Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanium Pickaxe. The Adamantite Pickaxe has slightly less pickaxe power, damage, and mining speed.
Its best modifier is Legendary. However, due to rounding, Legendary, Light, Deadly, Agile, Quick, and Nasty provide equal boosts to mining speed for this tool.
Adamantite Repeater: The Adamantite Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.
Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanium Repeater.
Adamantite Sword: The Adamantite Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.
Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanium Sword.
Adamantite Waraxe: The Adamantite Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Adamantite Chainsaw.
Its alternate ore counterpart is the Titanium Waraxe.
Its best modifier is Legendary. However, due to rounding, Legendary, Light, Deadly, Agile, Quick, and Nasty provide equal boosts to mining speed for this tool.
Adamantite armor: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings, as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet, Adamantite Mask, and Adamantite Headgear, providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively. Crafting a full set with one headpiece requires a total of 54 Adamantite Bars (216 Adamantite Ore). Crafting all five pieces requires a total of 78 Adamantite Bars (312 Adamantite Ore).
Its alternate ore counterpart is Titanium armor.
The player also emits a faint pulsating aura.
Adhesive Bandage: The Adhesive Bandage is an immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Bleeding debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Rusty Armored Bones, Werewolves, and Angler Fish.

While the Adhesive Bandage is exclusive to Hardmode on the Old-gen console version and Nintendo 3DS version, it can be obtained in pre-Hardmode on the Desktop version, Console version, and Mobile version by throwing a Bezoar into Shimmer.
Advanced Combat Techniques: Advanced Combat Techniques is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the defense of Town NPCs by 8, their attack damage by 25%, their attack speed by 20%, and their health by 250. Advanced Combat Techniques can only be obtained by fishing during a Blood Moon. It can only be used once per world, and others cannot be fished up once one has already been used. However, multiple copies can be obtained until the first is used. The chance of fishing it up when conditions are met is 1/360 (0.28%) with 50 Fishing Power and 1/180 (0.56%) with 100 Fishing Power (assuming neither Crate Potion nor Chum Caster is used and that the body of water is not too small).
When used, the status message “The book's knowledge empowers your villagers!” is displayed.
Advanced Combat Techniques: Volume Two: Advanced Combat Techniques: Volume Two is a Hardmode permanent booster item that permanently increases the defense of Town NPCs by 8, their attack damage by 25%, their attack speed by 20%, and their health by 250, similar to the increases after each type of boss is defeated. It can only be consumed once per world and is obtained by throwing a Spell Tome into Shimmer.
When used, the status message "The book's knowledge empowers your villagers!" is displayed.
Aegis Fruit: The Aegis Fruit is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's defense by 4. It can only be used once per player and is obtained by throwing a Life Fruit into Shimmer.
Aerial Bane: The Aerial Bane is a Hardmode, post-Golem bow that has a 1/4 (25%) of being dropped from Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One's Army event. When used, it converts any type of arrow into Aerial Bane arrows. The Aerial Bane fires a volley of six arrows per use, which travel in a sharp arc. Upon hitting an enemy, each arrow splits into five separate arrows, which are spread downwards. All arrows explode upon impact with enemies and blocks and deal 150% of the weapon's damage (64 base damage when using Wooden Arrows) against airborne enemies (i.e. enemies are considered airborne if the arrow's point of impact with them is more than 11 tiles above solid blocks). The Aerial Bane also has a base 7% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.
Aetherium Block: Aetherium Blocks are blocks formed when Shimmer comes into contact with any other liquid besides itself. Similarly to Ice Blocks, Aetherium Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions. This effect can be mitigated by equipping Ice Skates or other accessories crafted from them. Aetherium Blocks emit light when placed.
Aetherium Brick: The Aetherium Brick is a pre-Hardmode brick. It emits light when placed. Standing on Aetherium Bricks causes occasional particles of iridiscent star dust to appear. Walking or running on them causes a trail of particles to follow the player.
Aetherium Brick Wall: Aetherium Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Aetherium Bricks.
Aetherium Wall: Aetherium Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Aetherium Blocks.
Aglet: The Aglet is a pre-Hardmode movement accessory that increases the player's movement speed by 5%. The Aglet has a 1/11 (9.09%) chance of being found inside surface Chests, or a 1/120 (0.83%) chance in Wooden Crates and Pearlwood Crates obtained from fishing. It is also sold by the Skeleton Merchant for 2 Gold 50 Silver during a New Moon.
Alchemy Flask: The Alchemy Flask is a post-Skeletron crafting station used to craft potions. It has the same effect as the Alchemy Table when crafting potions: 1/3 (33.33%) chance for each ingredient not to be consumed. It is obtained by throwing an Alchemy Table into Shimmer. It fulfills a house's table requirement.

Pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate key on Alchemy Flask opens its crafting menu and grants the Alchemic Enhancement buff, which increases the duration of certain buffs by 20% (see Notes for complete list). The duration increase only applies to newly received buffs; existing buffs' duration will not be changed. This lasts until the player dies or leaves the world, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon.
Alchemy Table: The Alchemy Table is a post-Skeletron crafting station that shares recipes with Placed Bottles. When a potion is crafted with the Alchemy Table, there is a 1/3 (33.33%) chance for each ingredient not to be consumed. There is a separate probability check for each of the ingredients used in making the potion, including each of those in a stack.
The Alchemy Table can be found randomly in the Dungeon and can also be obtained by fishing in the Dungeon. It fulfills a house's table requirement.
Ale: Ale is a potion that grants the Tipsy debuff for 2 minutes when consumed. Ale can be crafted at a Keg or purchased from the Tavernkeep (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) for 1 Silver each.
The Tipsy debuff provides the following effects:
Reduces the time to produce Poo by 66.67%
Ale is also used as ammunition for the Ale Tosser (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), and can therefore be stored in the player's inventory ammo slots.
Ale Tosser: The Ale Tosser is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped from the Tavernkeep. When used, it consumes and fires Ale, which is affected by gravity and shatters upon contact with an enemy or a block, damaging enemies and affecting entities in a 9×9-tile square area. It has a 1/20 (5%) chance to inflict the Confused debuff on players in PvP and enemies for 2–5 seconds, and always inflicts Tipsy debuff on players and NPCs for 1 minute 0.98 seconds. The Tipsy debuff on NPCs grants 1.1× defense, 1.1× damage, and 0.9× attack interval (about +11% attack speed). The player also gains 10% increased ranged damage and 5% increased ranged critical strike chance if they are holding Ale Tosser while having the Tipsy debuff. The Ale Tosser has a 69% chance not to consume ammunition.
Alien Hornet: The Alien Hornet is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events, summoned from opened portals in groups of two. If not killed fast enough, it will fairly quickly grow into an Alien Queen. They also grow from the Alien Larva that spawned from the death of an Alien Queen.
Alien Larva: The Alien Larva is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. They move fairly slowly along the ground, and will only naturally spawn in groups of two or three upon the death of an Alien Queen. If unattended, they will grow into Alien Hornets, which in turn become Alien Queens later on.
Alien Queen: The Alien Queen is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist flying enemy that spawns in the area of the Vortex Pillar during the Lunar Events. It attacks by shooting Alien Goop projectiles that have a 1/2 (50%) / 100% chance to inflict the Distorted debuff for 6–12 / 5–9 seconds. The Distorted debuff causes the player to continually rise and fall in a short wave-like motion. The player's manual vertical movement is mostly disabled, with the exceptions of Hooks and teleporting with the Rod of Discord.
Upon death, the Alien Queen spawns two to three Alien Larvae. If not killed, they quickly grow into Alien Hornets which then grow into more Alien Queens.
Altars: Demon Altars and Crimson Altars are naturally-occurring crafting stations found mainly in and around chasms in The Corruption or Crimson, and less frequently underground. They are used to craft pre-Hardmode boss-summoning items and the Night's Edge as well as the Void Bag and Vault. Placed altars emit some light, making them easy to spot. They cannot be freed, picked up, or crafted. A Demon or Crimson Altar item will drop from the Eye of Cthulhu if no altars are present in the world.

Once a world enters Hardmode, they can be destroyed with any hammer that has 80% or greater hammer power. Hitting them with a hammer otherwise causes the player to lose half their health and will leave the altar unaffected.
Amarok: The Amarok is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/300 (0.33%) chance of being dropped from any enemy in the Snow biome or Ice biome, and can also drop in a Corrupted, Crimsoned, or Hallowed version of these biomes. It has a 67/100 (67%) chance to inflict the Frostbite debuff for 2–5 seconds upon hit.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.
Amazon: The Amazon is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.
Amber: Amber is a gem found within the Underground Desert of a world. It can craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and it also has three exclusive recipes: the Crate Potion, the Harpy Charm, and the Slasher's Mysterious Skull. It can only be obtained in the following ways, which differ from the other gems:
Mining the naturally generated placed form found in the Underground Desert.
Extracting from Silt, Slush, or Desert Fossil by putting them in an Extractinator.
Dropping from Geodes with a 2/7 (28.57%) chance.
Like all other gems, Amber can be placed on blocks, and can be crafted back into its Gemstone Block form at a Heavy Assembler in a Graveyard biome.
Amber Bunny: Gem Bunnies are harmless critters that can only spawn in the Cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Bunnies, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa.
Gem Bunnies have only 5 health and no defense, and can be damaged by other enemies and players.

Gem Bunnies can be caught with any Bug Net to be carried around in the inventory and released later, or crafted into animated decorative furniture (Gem Bunny Cages). Once crafted, the Gem Bunnies cannot be released again, unless the furniture item is de-crafted via Shimmer.
Amber Horseshoe Balloon: The Amber Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that increases jump height by 75% (6 blocks → 10.5 blocks), reduces it by 15% when underwater (8 blocks → 7 blocks), makes the player immune to fall damage, and releases bees when attacked, which seek out and damage enemies. It also grants +0.05 luck (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). It can be crafted at a Tinkerer's Workshop with a Lucky Horseshoe and a Honey Balloon. On the Desktop version, Console version, and Mobile version, it also grants the Honey buff after being damaged.
Amber Mosquito: The Amber Mosquito is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Dinosaur that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, a pterosaur will carry it by the tail to continue following them. The Amber Mosquito can be obtained by putting Silt, Slush, or Desert Fossils (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) into an Extractinator or Chlorophyte Extractinator (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions). With Silt or Slush, it only has a 1/10,000 (0.01%) chance to drop, while with Desert Fossils it has a slightly higher chance of 27/100,000 (0.027%).
Amber Robe: The Amber Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It is a gem robe and part of the Wizard set. The Amber Robe enchants gem staff projectiles to pierce an additional 2 enemies, and bounce up to 2 times on blocks, at the cost of dealing 80% damage. The Amber Staff instead receives a flat damage buff of 4, applied after the 80% damage multiplier.

Wearing the Wizard Hat alongside the Amber Robe provides a set bonus of +10% magic critical strike chance, whereas wearing a Magic Hat alongside it provides a set bonus of +60 mana. Any leg-slot equipment can be worn with these set bonuses remaining intact.
Amber Squirrel: Gem Squirrels are harmless critters that can only spawn in the cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Squirrels, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa. Gem Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.
Gem Squirrels have only 5 health and no defense, and can be damaged by other enemies and players.

Gem Squirrels can be caught with any Bug Net to be carried around in the inventory and released later, or crafted into animated decorative furniture (Gem Squirrel Cages). Once crafted, the Gem Squirrels cannot be released again, unless the furniture item is de-crafted via Shimmer.
Amber Staff: The Amber Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires an orange bolt which deals 80% of the weapon's damage (16 base damage) and 100% of its knockback, and can either pierce through enemies or bounce off blocks up to 2 times, dissipating upon the 3rd hit. While wearing a Gem robe, the fired bolt will be enchanted by ability of the corresponding gem type, granting it additional effects (see Notes for details).
Ambrosia: Ambrosia is a permanent booster item that permanently grants the following effects:
+5% placement speed when placing blocks and walls
It can only be used once per player and is obtained by throwing any type of fruit into Shimmer.
Amethyst: Amethyst is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world. Out of all available gems, Amethyst is the least valuable gem, being able to craft the its corresponding set of standard gem items, and has no exclusive recipes. It can be obtained in the following ways:
Mining the naturally generated placed form, Gemstone Blocks form with noticeable purple gemstones embedded in it, or Gem stash background object form.
Extracting from Silt, Slush, or Desert Fossil by putting them in an Extractinator.
Dropping from Geodes with a 2/7 (28.57%) chance.
Rarely, Amethyst can be found in bulk in its own Gemstone Cave micro-biome, or in one that contains other gems as well.
Like all other gems, Amethyst can be placed on blocks, and can be crafted back into its Gemstone Block form at a Heavy Assembler in a Graveyard biome.
Amethyst Bunny: Gem Bunnies are harmless critters that can only spawn in the Cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Bunnies, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa.
Gem Bunnies have only 5 health and no defense, and can be damaged by other enemies and players.

Gem Bunnies can be caught with any Bug Net to be carried around in the inventory and released later, or crafted into animated decorative furniture (Gem Bunny Cages). Once crafted, the Gem Bunnies cannot be released again, unless the furniture item is de-crafted via Shimmer.
Amethyst Robe: The Amethyst Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot. It is a gem robe and part of the Wizard set. The Amethyst Robe enchants gem staff projectiles to home in towards the nearest enemy. The Amethyst Staff instead receives a flat damage buff of 4.

Wearing the Wizard Hat alongside the Amethyst Robe provides a set bonus of +10% magic critical strike chance, whereas wearing a Magic Hat alongside it provides a set bonus of +60 mana. Any leg-slot equipment can be worn with these set bonuses remaining intact.
Amethyst Squirrel: Gem Squirrels are harmless critters that can only spawn in the cavern layer near town NPCs, and have a higher spawn chance during rain. There are 7 variants of Gem Squirrels, with each corresponding to a gem type. The spawn chance of each variant depends on the rarity of its respective gem type, meaning the variants corresponding to a more common gem will spawn more often, and vice versa. Gem Squirrels may turn hostile to players with negative luck; see hostile critter for details.
Gem Squirrels have only 5 health and no defense, and can be damaged by other enemies and players.

Gem Squirrels can be caught with any Bug Net to be carried around in the inventory and released later, or crafted into animated decorative furniture (Gem Squirrel Cages). Once crafted, the Gem Squirrels cannot be released again, unless the furniture item is de-crafted via Shimmer.
Amethyst Staff: The Amethyst Staff is a pre-Hardmode wand and type of gem staff that fires a purple bolt which does not pierce and homes onto the closest enemy within a 31.25-tile radius. While wearing a Gem robe, the fired bolt will be enchanted by ability of the corresponding gem type, granting it additional effects (see Notes for details).
Ammo Box: The Ammo Box is a furniture item. It can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 10 Gold in Hardmode.

Placing and pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on the Ammo Box grants the Ammo Box buff, which provides ranged weapons with a 1/5 (20%) chance per shot not to consume ammunition. This lasts until the player dies or leaves the world. The buff can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon.

Unlike equipment buff items, the Ammo Box must be placed in order to activate the buff. It can be mined with a pickaxe or drill and picked up again, even while the buff is active, which will not cancel the buff. Placement is only dependent on an adequate space of 2×2 tiles being available.
Ammo Reservation Potion: The Ammo Reservation Potion is a buff potion which grants the Ammo Reservation buff when consumed. The buff reduces the chance of consuming any ammunition by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon.
Amphibian Boots: The Amphibian Boots are an accessory crafted by combining the Sailfish Boots and Frog Leg at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It provides the benefits of both.
Equipping it has the following effects:
Increases the player's maximum movement speed to 22.5 tiles/second (31 mph)
Increases the maximum safe falling distance by 10 tiles
Amulet of the Night: The Amulet of the Night is a Hardmode transformation mount item that turns the player into a Bat. While in bat form, the player has infinite flight and their hurt sound is replaced with a squeak. The bat form has a top movement speed of 23 mph when moving in the cardinal directions, and a top movement speed of 33 mph pixels when moving diagonally. If the player has any dashes equipped, they can also perform a dash with a special animation by pressing Dash, or by double-tapping ◀ Left or ▶ Right while the "Double Tap Dashing" setting is enabled. The player will be pulled out of the form when any of the following occurs:
The player uses or places any item, including weapons.
The player is submerged in liquids or is inflicted with the Wet debuff.
The Amulet of the Night is dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse and can be found in naturally generated chests in the Vampirism secret world seed.
Anchor: The Anchor is a Hardmode flail that has a 3.78% chance of being found in Pearlwood Crates, obtained from fishing. When used, it fires an Anchor in an arc, which is attached to the player via a rope. The Anchor can pierce an unlimited number of enemies in its way and returns upon hitting solid blocks or after traveling for more than 50 tiles away from the player. If it has traveled for at least 0.17 seconds, it creates a shockwave upon colliding with blocks that deals 60% of the weapon's damage (42 base damage) and 150% of its knockback (base knockback of 12 (Insane)) to enemies within a 18.75×18.75-tile square area centered on the projectile. Both the Anchor and its shockwave have a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to inflict the Confused debuff for 1–2 seconds on hit.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.
Ancient Chisel: The Ancient Chisel is a construction accessory that increases mining speed by 25%, similarly to a Mining Potion. It can be found in Sandstone Chests in the top 4/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.
Ancient Cloth: Ancient Cloth is an uncommon Hardmode crafting material which has a 1/10 (10%) chance of dropping from all types of Ghouls.
Ancient Cobalt Brick: Ancient Cobalt Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Cobalt Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Cobalt Brick prior to 1.2.
Ancient Cobalt Brick Wall: Ancient Cobalt Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Cobalt Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Cobalt Brick Wall prior to 1.2.
Ancient Cobalt armor: Ancient Cobalt armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Cobalt Helmet, Ancient Cobalt Breastplate, and Ancient Cobalt Leggings. Each piece has a 1/300 (0.33%) chance of being dropped by Hornets and Man Eaters.
It shares identical stats with Jungle armor, but differs in appearance. Ancient Cobalt armor pieces are interchangeable with Jungle armor pieces, still providing the set bonus.
The player also emits a visual afterimage while moving instead of grass particles.
Ancient Copper Brick: Ancient Copper Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Copper Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Copper Brick prior to 1.2.
Ancient Copper Brick Wall: Ancient Copper Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Copper Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Copper Brick Wall prior to 1.2.
Ancient Dungeon Brick Walls: The Ancient Dungeon Brick Walls are types of walls that are crafted from their respective Ancient Dungeon Brick.
Ancient Dungeon Bricks: Ancient Dungeon Bricks are explosion-proof bricks that can be obtained by throwing the respective Dungeon Brick into Shimmer.
Ancient Gold Brick: Ancient Gold Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Gold Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Gold Brick prior to 1.2.
Ancient Gold Brick Wall: Ancient Gold Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Gold Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Gold Brick Wall prior to 1.2.
Ancient Hallowed armor: Ancient Hallowed armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ancient Hallowed Plate Mail and Ancient Hallowed Greaves, as well as four different headpieces: the Ancient Hallowed Mask, Ancient Hallowed Helmet, Ancient Hallowed Headgear, and Ancient Hallowed Hood.

It shares identical stats with Hallowed armor, but differs in appearance and is crafted at an altar instead. Ancient Hallowed armor pieces are interchangeable with Hallowed armor pieces, still providing the set bonus.
Ancient Hellstone Brick: Ancient Hellstone Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Hellstone Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Hellstone Brick prior to 1.2.

Like plain Hellstone Bricks, players without an Obsidian Skull or one of its upgrades in their accessory slot will receive the Burning debuff from making contact with the brick. Mining the block or carrying it in one's inventory incurs no negative effect, however. As with most damaging blocks, NPCs and enemies are immune to this damage.
Ancient Hellstone Brick Wall: Ancient Hellstone Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Hellstone Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Hellstone Brick Wall prior to 1.2.
Ancient Horn: The Ancient Horn is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Basilisk Mount, which gives the player an additional jump and the ability to charge through enemies, damaging them in the process. The Ancient Horn has a 1/50 (2%) chance of being dropped by Basilisks.

The Basilisk mount provides accelerated land speed at 41 mph and provides increased jump height (14 tiles/28 feet), though is still hindered by water as usual. While mounted on the Basilisk, the player is immune to knockback and only takes 20% fall damage.

If the Basilisk is moving at a speed of least 21 mph, running through enemies inflicts 90 base damage, not counting enemy defense. This damage is considered summon damage, meaning that minion-enhancing items will improve it. Enemies that are damaged by this attack do not inflict contact damage on the player, but the player will suffer contact damage from enemies that survive it, if the hitbox of the player gets hit.
The mount emits a faint red glow from 27' underground downwards. This light does not grow stronger as the player descends, and its color is unaffected by dyes.
Ancient Manipulator: The Ancient Manipulator is a Hardmode crafting station that is always dropped by the Lunatic Cultist. It is mainly used to craft items from Luminite and Lunar Fragments.
Ancient Mythril Brick: Ancient Mythril Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Mythril Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Mythril Brick prior to 1.2.
Ancient Mythril Brick Wall: Ancient Mythril Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Mythril Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Mythril Brick Wall prior to 1.2.
Ancient Obsidian Brick: Ancient Obsidian Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Obsidian Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Obsidian Brick prior to 1.2.
Ancient Obsidian Brick Wall: Ancient Obsidian Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Obsidian Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Obsidian Brick Wall prior to 1.2.
Ancient Shadow armor: Ancient Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set obtained from Eater of Souls. Each piece is dropped individually with a 1/525 (0.19%) chance.

It shares identical stats with Shadow armor, but it reproduces the pre-1.0.3 Shadow armor's sprites. Ancient Shadow armor pieces are interchangeable with Shadow armor pieces, still providing the set bonus.

The player will also emit purple bubbles, and create a semi-transparent after-image effect behind themselves when moving. This effect appears to be clones of the player. These clones do not appear to have bodies inside of the armor, as there is no face visible.
Ancient Silver Brick: Ancient Silver Brick is a type of brick obtained by throwing Silver Brick into Shimmer. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Silver Brick prior to 1.2.
Ancient Silver Brick Wall: Ancient Silver Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Ancient Silver Bricks. Its appearance is based on the sprite of Silver Brick Wall prior to 1.2.
Ancient Vision: The Ancient Vision is a Hardmode boss servant that is summoned by the Lunatic Cultist. It is only summoned if a player attacks a duplicate of the Lunatic Cultist while a Phantasm Dragon is still alive. The Ancient Vision attacks by repeatedly charging at the player horizontally, back and forth, similar to Mothron's charge attacks. The Ancient Vision leaves behind afterimages as it flies.
Ancient set: The Ancient set is a Hardmode vanity set that consists of the Ancient Headdress, Ancient Garments, and Ancient Slacks. These items are to be equipped in the Social Slots as they only provide a visual appearance.
Angel Halo: The Angel Halo is a vanity accessory purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 40 Gold.
The Angel Halo cannot be reforged, and therefore cannot have modifiers.
Angler: The Angler is a unique NPC concerned exclusively with fishing. He does not sell anything, but rather assigns quests to players. Quest objectives generally involve catching him rare fish from particular biomes or layers, for which he offers various rewards. He will move in once the following criteria have been met:
There is an available vacant house.

He has been rescued as the Sleeping Angler, who can be encountered randomly in the Ocean biome on Sand Blocks or on the surface of the water. Interacting with him in this state with ⚷ Open / Activate will wake him. If the Sleeping Angler is killed, he will still be able to respawn afterwards; if the Angler NPC is killed, he will move in again after some time as long as there is a vacant house.
The Angler will defend himself against nearby enemies by throwing Frost Daggerfish. He deals 10 / 15 / 17 damage at the start of the game, and gains various stat boosts as the player progresses.
The Sleeping Angler is one of the few entities that can be detected by the Lifeform Analyzer or its upgrades.
Angler Earring: The Angler Earring is an accessory that increases the player's current Fishing Power by 10 when equipped. The Angler Earring can be acquired as a 1/34 (2.94%) chance reward for completing a fishing quest for the Angler NPC, depending on the number of completed quests and other factors (see Angler § Quest rewards for details).

The Angler will not give the player an Angler Earring as a reward if they already have one in their inventory or in any of their portable storage items or loadouts. However, if the player has all of the Angler's fishing and informational accessories (or their upgrades like the Angler Tackle Bag and Fish Finder) in their inventories, this rule will be ignored.
Angler Fish: The Angler Fish is a Hardmode enemy which spawns in the Cavern layer, and any layer in the Jungle. It swims faster than Piranhas when chasing the player, and can inflict the Bleeding debuff for 45 / 90 / 112.5 seconds. It has a small glowing bulb sprouting from its head that emits a small amount of light.
Angler Tackle Bag: The Angler Tackle Bag is an accessory that combines the functionality of its components: the Angler Earring's +10 boost to Fishing Power, the Tackle Box's chance to not consume bait, and the unbreakable quality of the High Test Fishing Line.

The Angler Tackle Bag's increase in Fishing Power stacks with that of the Angler Earring and Lavaproof Tackle Bag, granting a total boost of +30 if all three are equipped. The decreased chance to consume bait does not stack with that of the Tackle Box or the Lavaproof Tackle Bag.
Angler armor: Angler armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Angler Hat, Angler Vest, and Angler Pants. The Hat is given by the Angler after completing 10 fishing quests, the Vest after 15, and the Pants after 20.
The full set grants the following effects while equipped:
-24% enemy spawn rates and -30% maximum enemy count
Angler armor pieces are interchangeable with pieces from Captain armor, still providing the set bonus. The only difference is the defense.
Angry Bones: The Angry Bones is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in the Dungeon. They follow the Fighter AI and can open closed doors after one or two hits. They will sometimes leap towards the player when they get close, or if the player is above them.
Angry Dandelion: The Angry Dandelion is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns on grass during the Windy Day event at daytime. It is stationary and shoots 1–3 damaging Dandelion Seed projectiles at the player every 0.67 seconds.
Angry Nimbus: The Angry Nimbus is a Hardmode enemy that spawns when the weather is rainy in any surface biome except for the Snow biome. It will follow players around the map and attempt to release damaging raindrops on top of them similar to that of the Crimson Rod and the Nimbus Rod. It floats directly above the player, making it difficult to hit with close-range weapons.
Angry Trapper: The Angry Trapper is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Jungle and Underground Jungle biomes and is a much stronger version of the Man Eater and Snatcher.
Angry Tumbler: The Angry Tumbler is a pre-Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Desert during a Sandstorm. It attacks by rolling towards the player, moving at very high speeds when rolling with in the direction of the Mighty Wind.
Animal skins: The animal skins are decorative furniture items that are used like paintings. They are purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 1 Gold each.
Ankh Charm: The Ankh Charm is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the following debuffs:
Ankh Shield: The Ankh Shield is a Hardmode shield and immunity accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Anklet of the Wind: The Anklet of the Wind is an accessory that gives a 10% bonus to movement speed. The effect also stacks with the movement speed bonus of the Aglet. It can be found in Jungle and Bramble Crates with a 19% chance, and also in Ivy Chests located in Jungle Shrines and at the base of a Living Mahogany Tree in the Underground Jungle with a 21.72% chance.
Announcement Box: The Announcement Box is a special sign that, when powered, will announce (in the chat) what was written on the sign. They support the usage of tags, allowing (for example) the display of messages in different colors.
Anomura Fungus: The Anomura Fungus is an enemy found in aboveground Glowing Mushroom biomes at any point in the game, including pre-Hardmode. During Hardmode, they can also spawn in underground Glowing Mushroom biomes.
Anti-Gravity Hook: The Anti-Gravity Hook is a Hardmode, post-Golem grappling hook that fires up to three hooks which reach 31.25 tiles at maximum. When any hook latches onto a block, the player will be pushed 12 blocks away from the latch point if there is room to do so. While latched to a block, the player can use the movement keys to orbit around the latch point, or reposition themselves if they are caught between two or three latch points; however, they will return to the farthest point when they let go of the movement keys.
The Anti-Gravity Hook has a 1/800 (0.13%) chance of being dropped from all basic enemies during the Martian Madness event.
Anti-Portal Block: The Anti-Portal Block is a Hardmode block that prevents portals from the Portal Gun or Portal Gun Station to form on it. It is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 1 Silver.
Antlion: The Antlion is a pre-Hardmode enemy found in Deserts during the day and in Underground Deserts at any time. It remains stationary with its head sticking out of the ground, turns its head towards the player when they are within its line of sight, and fires Sand Ball projectiles at them once every 3.33 seconds. It can only launch projectiles at an upward angle (within about 45° to the left and right), so players that are approaching from lower ground are usually out of its line of fire. Sand Balls turn into Sand Blocks upon hitting an object, and will gather on the ground, similarly to the projectiles fired by the Sandgun.
Antlion Charger: The Antlion Charger is an enemy similar in appearance to the Antlion, and is found in the Underground Desert or on surface Deserts during pre-Hardmode Sandstorms. Unlike the Antlion, the Antlion Charger will, as its name suggests, charge at the player instead of remaining stationary. It can jump over blocks and will gradually build up speed while moving before charging the player. It can rarely drop the Mandible Blade.
Antlion Eggs: Antlion Eggs are background objects that are found in naturally-generated clusters in the Underground Desert. They spawn an Antlion Larva when hit with nearly any tool, weapon, or projectile.
Antlion Larva: The Antlion Larva is a pre-Hardmode enemy that is only spawned when Antlion Eggs are destroyed. Its speed, jump height, occurrence in numbers, and small size make it a significant threat in the early game.

Multiple Antlion Larvae can spawn from a single egg, which breaks when hit with any weapon or tool. Unlike the Alien Larva, Antlion Larvae will not grow into an Antlion, Antlion Charger, or Antlion Swarmer.
Antlion Mandible: The Antlion Mandible is a crafting material dropped by Antlions, Antlion Larvae, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers found in the Desert and Underground Desert biomes.
Antlion Swarmer: The Antlion Swarmer is a pre-Hardmode flying enemy found in the Underground Desert or on surface Deserts during Sandstorms. It is a large dragonfly-like creature that looks similar to the Antlion and Antlion Charger.
Apple: The Apple is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed. This lasts for 5 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon.
It has a small chance of dropping when shaking a Forest tree.
Apple Juice: Apple Juice is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed. This lasts for 10 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon.
Apple Pie: The Apple Pie is a Hardmode food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. This lasts for 16 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon. The Apple Pie has a 1/150 (0.67%) chance of being dropped by Illuminant Bats, Illuminant Slimes, and Chaos Elementals.
Apple Pie Slice: The Apple Pie Slice is an unimplemented item.
Apprentice armor: Apprentice armor is a Hardmode mage/summoner armor set consisting of the Apprentice's Hat, Apprentice's Robe, and Apprentice's Trousers. The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of 45 Defender Medals after defeating any mechanical boss.
The Dark Artist armor can be considered a direct upgrade of the Apprentice armor.
The full set grants the following effects while equipped:
Flameburst sentry summons have 50% increased attack range (84 tiles), 40% increased projectile velocity, and significantly increased field of view.
Apprentice's Scarf: The Apprentice's Scarf is an accessory that increases the player's sentry slots by one and increases summon damage by 10%. It is dropped by the Dark Mage with a 1/4 (25%) / 1/2 (50%) chance.
Apricot: The Apricot is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed. This lasts for 5 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon.
It has a small chance of dropping when shaking a Forest tree.
Aqua Scepter: The Aqua Scepter is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires arcing streams of water in quick succession, with each stream being able to hit up to 5 targets. The water streams bounce upwards upon colliding with lava. They pierce infinitely after a bounce, move slower, are less affected by gravity and can last for a significantly longer time.

The Aqua Scepter has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions).
Aquarium Block: Aquarium Blocks are a block crafted from Glass near water, Sink, or a Water fountain. Their main use is crafting Aquarium furniture and Aquarium Walls.
Aquarium Wall: Aquarium Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Aquarium Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.
Arapaima: The Arapaima is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in pools of water within the Jungle and Underground Jungle biomes. It swims much faster than most fish and deals high damage, but it has no knockback resistance, so high-knockback weapons are useful. The Arapaima can jump from the water and therefore is able to attack players on land close to the water.
Arc Surge: The Arc Surge is a Hardmode, post-Golem magic weapon that has a 1/50 (2%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event. When used, it rapidly fires instantaneous red lightning arcs at the cursor's location, which can reach anywhere on the screen and pierce enemies infinitely with no damage penalty, but cannot pass through blocks or enter liquids. The Arc Surge can also fire extra lightning arcs towards up to 2 nearby enemies in addition to the lightning arc aimed at the cursor, for a total of 3 lightning arcs per fire (see Notes for details on this mechanic). The lightning arcs inflict the Zapped debuff for 4–7 seconds on enemies and other players in PvP.
Arcane Crystal: The Arcane Crystal is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's mana regeneration by 1/50 (2%) of their maximum mana. It can only be used once per player and is obtained by throwing a Mana Crystal into Shimmer.
See Mana § Restoring mana for details about mana regeneration.
Arcane Flower: The Arcane Flower is a Hardmode accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:
Automatically consumes mana potions in the player's inventory or opened Void Bag when mana is depleted.
Arcane Rune Wall: Arcane Rune Wall is a background wall that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 Silver 50 Copper each. It is one of the few animated walls, as the runes displayed change every few seconds.
Archaeologist's set: The Archaeologist's set is a vanity set composed of the Archaeologist's Hat, the Archaeologist's Jacket and the Archaeologist's Pants. These items are to be equipped in the Social Slots as they only provide a visual appearance.
While two of the pieces are crafted, the Archaeologist's Hat is not, but rather has a guaranteed chance to drop from Doctor Bones.

It is possible to craft these items in a world that has The Crimson instead of The Corruption by creating an artificial Corruption, by bringing Leather over from a world with the Corruption, or by using a Corrupt Statue to spawn Eaters of Souls.
Archery Potion: The Archery Potion is a buff potion which grants the Archery buff when consumed. The buff increases the damage of arrow-firing weapons by 10%, as well as the velocity of arrows by 20%. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon.
In addition to being crafted, Archery Potions can be found in Pots and Chests.
Architect Gizmo Pack: The Architect Gizmo Pack is a construction accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
+50% placement speed when placing blocks and walls
Increased placement range and tool range by 2 tiles vertically and 3 tiles horizontally
Automatically applies paint or coating to placed objects
All four items required to create the Architect Gizmo Pack are sold by the Traveling Merchant for 40 Gold in total.
Arctic Diving Gear: The Arctic Diving Gear is an accessory which is crafted by combining the Jellyfish Diving Gear and Ice Skates at a Tinkerer's Workshop. It combines the functionalities of its ingredients:
The player can swim upwards in any liquid by holding or pressing ↷ Jump repeatedly.
The player's breath meter will deplete much slower, and the rate at which drowning damage is taken is slowed.
The player emits light when submerged in water and honey, and emits very faint light out of water and honey.
Increased acceleration and deceleration on all Ice Blocks, Thin Ice, Frozen Slime Blocks, and Aetherium Blocks. The player will no longer cause Thin Ice to break upon landing.
Besides these effects, it also prevents the Chilled debuff when touching water in Snow or Ice biomes in Expert Mode.
Argon Moss Brick: Argon Moss Brick is a type of brick made from Argon Moss that glows in the dark when placed.
Argon Moss Brick Wall: Argon Moss Brick Wall is a brick background wall that glows in the dark when placed, like Argon Moss and the Argon Moss Brick it is made from.
Arkhalis: The Arkhalis is a Hardmode melee weapon that is part of Arkhalis' set and is only obtainable through Hardmode Treasure Bags in Expert Mode (except Queen Slime's). It appears to be a sword, but does not present an actual blade when used. Instead of an overhead broadsword swing or a shortsword stab, the Arkhalis autoswings and appears as a series of blurred slashes aimed in the direction of the cursor. Anything within this area takes constant damage at a rate far exceeding the weapon's stated use time. This damaging area has a rather wide spread, even attacking behind the player for a very short distance. In addition, the Arkhalis has 20 armor penetration.
The Terragrim is the Arkhalis's weaker, pre-Hardmode variant that is obtainable from Enchanted Sword Shrines.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount. The Arkhalis's unique means of attack is unaffected by any size and speed modifiers.
Arkhalis' set: Arkhalis' set are vanity developer items that can be obtained rarely (6.25% chance) from Treasure Bags dropped from Hardmode bosses (except Queen Slime's). It is the vanity set made for Arkhayla, a former Quality Director at Re-Logic.
These items are to be equipped in the Social Slots as they only provide a visual appearance.
Arkhalis' equipment also includes these non-vanity items, which will drop in addition to her clothing set:
Armlet Of Ruin: The Armlet Of Ruin is a Hardmode accessory. It grants the following effects while equipped:
Summon tag hits are periodically boosted, and discharge ancient power on hit.
This effect has a cooldown of 6 seconds, indicated by faint blue light.
Boosted hits deal up to 170 additional base damage.
Ancient power hit up to 2 additional targets nearby, dealing 150 base damage and a knockback of 5 (Average) to each target.
Armor Bracing: Armor Bracing is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Weak and Broken Armor debuffs.
Armor Polish: The Armor Polish is a Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Broken Armor debuff. It has a 1/100 (1%) / 199/10000 (1.99%) chance to drop from Armored Skeletons and Blue Armored Bones.
Armored Cavefish: Armored Cavefish are a type of fish which are found uncommonly by fishing in the Underground, Cavern, and Underworld layers, in any biome (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) except the Desert. They are used to craft Seafood Dinners and Endurance Potions.
Armored Skeleton: The Armored Skeleton is a Hardmode enemy that spawns in the Cavern layer. It has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance to inflict the Broken Armor debuff for 2 / 4 / 5 minutes on contact.
Armored Viking: The Armored Viking is a Hardmode enemy found in the Ice biome. It is similar to the Undead Viking, but has greatly increased defense, damage and health.
Arms Dealer: The Arms Dealer is an NPC vendor who mainly sells ammunition items as well as guns. He will move in once the following criteria have been met:
There is an available vacant house.

The player has at least one bullet or bullet-firing gun in their inventory (guns and bullets stored in storage items like chests, or portable storage items like the Piggy Bank do not count towards this requirement).
These requirements only apply to the initial spawning. If the Arms Dealer is killed, he will automatically respawn after some time.

The Arms Dealer will defend himself against nearby enemies with a Flintlock Pistol, before upgrading to a Minishark during Hardmode. He deals 24 / 36 / 42 damage in pre-Hardmode, which decreases to 15 / 22 / 26 damage in Hardmode to balance the Minishark's fire rate, and gains various stat boosts as the player progresses.
Arrow Signs: Arrow Signs are furniture items used in Golfing. They are purely decorative and come in a regular and a painted variety. They are both purchased from the Golfer for 20 Silver each.
It is possible to turn the orientation of arrows with a right-click (⚷ Open / Activate) into 8 different directions.
Artery: The Artery is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.
It is the Crimson counterpart to The Corruption's Malaise. The Artery has slightly higher damage and reach than the Malaise, but slightly lower knockback and spin duration.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.
Artisan Loaf: The Artisan Loaf is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the range that the player can access crafting stations by 4 tiles in all directions. The Artisan Loaf can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 10 Gold during a Waning Crescent, New Moon, or Waxing Crescent. It can also only be used once per player, and the Skeleton Merchant will cease to sell it once the player has consumed an Artisan Loaf.
Ash Block: The Ash Block is a block that covers the upper and lower sections of The Underworld, and can occasionally encase Hellstone. It can be used for building and for growing Fireblossom.

(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) In the Ash forests on the outer edges of the Underworld, Ash grass naturally generates on Ash Blocks, with Ash trees growing on them. Ash Grass Seeds can be planted on Ash Blocks.
Ash Grass Seeds: Ash Grass Seeds are seeds used to plant Ash grass. They are purchased from the Dryad for 1 Silver 50 Copper each, when she is talked to in The Underworld. They can also be gathered by clearing Ash grass foliage in the Underworld. Ash trees can grow on planted Ash grass. Ash grass, Ash trees, and the plants that grow on the grass, emit faint light.
Ash Wood: Ash Wood is a type of wood harvested from Ash trees found naturally growing in Ash forests. Ash trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of Ash grass at any height.
Ash Wood Bow: The Ash Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.
Its best modifier is Demonic, as it does not have any knockback and thus cannot get modifiers that affect it.
Ash Wood Hammer: The Ash Wood Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.
Its best modifier is Light for harvesting purposes and Legendary for combat purposes.
Ash Wood Sword: The Ash Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.
Ash Wood Wall: Ash Wood Wall is a type of background wall crafted using Ash Wood.
Ash Wood armor: Ash Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Ash Wood Helmet, Ash Wood Breastplate, and Ash Wood Greaves. Crafting the full set requires a total of 75 Ash Wood.
The full set grants the following effects while equipped:
Reduces the contact damage of lava from 80 to 40.
Halves the duration of the On Fire! debuff from contact with lava from 7 / 14 / 17.5 seconds to 3.5 / 7 / 8.75 seconds.
Additionally, equipping both Ash Wood armor and the Obsidian Rose (or its upgrades) provides immunity to lava damage and the debuff.
Asphalt Block: The Asphalt Block is a unique Hardmode block that multiplies the top speed of players running along it by 3.5×, and doubles the rate of deceleration when slowing down. It only increases the player's normal movement speed, stacking multiplicatively with buffs such as Swiftness and Well Fed, and does not directly increase acceleration. It only affects players running directly on it; the speed of enemies, NPCs, and critters will remain unaffected. Immediately after jumping or falling off of Asphalt Block, the speed will return to normal.
With no other boosts, running on Asphalt gives the player a maximum running speed of 53 mph, with about 3 seconds of acceleration, while the normal maximum running speed is 15 mph.
Astra Brick: Astra Brick is a type of decorative brick obtained by throwing Luminite Brick into Shimmer during a Third Quarter.
Astra Brick Wall: Astra Brick Wall is a type of background wall crafted from Astra Bricks.
Atlantic Cod: Atlantic Cods are a type of fish which are found commonly by fishing in a Snow biome in any layer.
Autohammer: The Autohammer is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Shroomite Bars as well as Mini Nuke I and II. It can be purchased from the Truffle for 1 Platinum after Plantera has been defeated.
Avenger Emblem: The Avenger Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that grants 12% increased damage to all weapons.
Axe of Regrowth: The Axe of Regrowth is a pre-Hardmode axe crafted from the Staff of Regrowth. It retains the same functions and additionally replants felled trees that can grow from Acorns without requiring or consuming Acorns from the player's inventory.
Its best modifier is Light for harvesting purposes and Legendary for combat purposes.
Axearang: The Axearang is a pre-Hardmode axe and boomerang obtained by throwing an Axe of Regrowth into Shimmer. It instantly chops down any tree in its path after being thrown, but not when returning to the player. It can also chop down Glowing Mushroom Trees and gem trees, but not Cacti.
The Guide to Environmental Preservation will prevent the Axearang from chopping down trees.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.
Azure Crate: The Azure Crate is a Hardmode crate that can only be fished in Space, e.g. in Floating Lakes. It contains items found in standard crates and always contains an item normally found in Skyware Chests (with the exception of the Sky Mill). Its pre-Hardmode counterpart is the Sky Crate.
BBQ Ribs: The BBQ Ribs are a Hardmode food item that grant the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. This lasts for 24 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon. The BBQ Ribs have a 1/21 (4.76%) chance of being dropped by Skeleton Commandos, Skeleton Snipers, and Tactical Skeletons, and a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped by Paladins.
Baby Grinch's Mischief Whistle: The Baby Grinch's Mischief Whistle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Grinch that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, a red balloon will carry the Baby Grinch to catch up with them. The Baby Grinch's Mischief Whistle is dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 1.11%–2.22% (3.33%–6.67%) chance depending on the current wave.
Baby Mothron: Mothron is a rare, powerful, Hardmode, post-Plantera, flying enemy that spawns during the Solar Eclipse event. Mothron can pass through all blocks and attacks by chasing after the player or aligning itself horizontally with them before lunging towards them at varying speeds, inflicting heavy contact damage depending on its velocity. Occasionally, it lands on blocks to lay several Mothron Eggs that spawn Baby Mothrons if they are not destroyed in time, much like Lepus (3DS version).

It is one of the few entities that can be detected by the Lifeform Analyzer or its upgrades. Mothron requires 25 kills to be awarded completion of its Bestiary entry and corresponding banner, as opposed to the usual 50 kills.
Baby Slime: The Baby Slime is a pre-Hardmode enemy and a slime variant that spawns in groups of 1–3 from a defeated Mother Slime.
Like most other slimes, the Baby Slime will be passive towards any player with the Royal Gel (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) accessory equipped.
On Desktop, Console, Mobile, and 3DS, they can rarely be found carrying bonus drops, which the player receives upon the slime's death.
Bacon: The Bacon is a Hardmode food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed. This lasts for 24 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon. The Bacon has a 1/15 (6.67%) chance of being dropped by Pigron. Statue-spawned Pigrons do not drop it, as it is a food item.
Badger's Hat: Badger's Hat is a Hardmode vanity item dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu or the Wall of Flesh when they are both defeated on the same day (from 7:30 PM to 7:30 PM the next day).
Bait: Bait is a category of items required for fishing. When a fishing pole is cast, at least one bait item must be in the player's inventory; otherwise, nothing can be caught. Fishing poles will cast their lines with no baits, but there will be no "bites" and no catches. The bait item is only consumed once the player reels in the line with a catch on the hook. It is not consumed upon the player casting the line or the line being reeled in with no catch. Even when the player does reel in a fish, there is only a chance that the bait will be consumed.
There are several items that can serve as bait, and they must be obtained in different ways depending on the type:

Most critters that are invertebrates (insects, scorpions, snails, worms) can be used as bait, and must be caught with the Bug Net, Lavaproof Bug Net (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), or Golden Bug Net (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions).
Worms from a Can Of Worms found in surface chests can be used for fishing before the Bug Net can be bought.
The Truffle Worm is unique in that it is only used for summoning Duke Fishron. It cannot be used for ordinary fishing.

The Magma Snail (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), Hell Butterfly (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), and Lavafly (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) can only be caught with a Lavaproof Bug Net or Golden Bug Net. When used as bait, they have the special property of allowing the player to fish in lava.
Blue, Green, and Pink Jellyfish bait items are unrelated to the Jellyfish enemies. They are themselves caught via fishing.

Apprentice Bait, Journeyman Bait, and Master Bait are acquired as rewards for completing quests for the Angler NPC, as well as from crates. Apprentice Bait and Journeyman bait can also be obtained by putting one of the three Junk items in an Extractinator, while Master Bait is also dropped by Jungle Mimics (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions).
Ball O' Fuse Wire: The Ball O' Fuse Wire is a Hardmode pet-summoning item that spawns a Dynamite Kitten, which resembles the Orange Tabby variant of the Town Cat, that follows the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Kitten will ride towards them on a stick of Dynamite and immediately dismount when it is on solid ground. The Ball O' Fuse Wire can be purchased from the Zoologist for 50 Gold after completing 70% (383 entries) of the Bestiary.
Ball O' Hurt: The Ball O' Hurt is a pre-Hardmode flail that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in The Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption.
Its Crimson flail counterpart is The Meatball. Its Crimson Heart melee weapon counterpart is The Rotted Fork.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.
Balla Hat: The Balla Hat is a vanity item purchased from the Clothier after the Frost Legion has been defeated.
On the Desktop version, Console version, and Mobile version, it can only be purchased during the day, for 1 Gold.
On the Old-gen console version and Nintendo 3DS version, it can be obtained for free at any time.
Ballista sentry summons: The Ballista Rod, Cane, and Staff are special sentry summon weapons that summon their respective sentries. Each Ballista sentry fires Ballista Shot projectiles towards enemies, which pierce three times. Ballistas deal high damage but have a slow firing speed. The higher the tier, the more damage the Ballistas deal.
The Rod is sold by the Tavernkeep for 5 Defender Medals. The Cane is sold for 15 Defender Medals after defeating one mechanical boss. The Staff is sold for 60 Defender Medals after defeating Golem.

During the Old One's Army event, Etherian Mana can be collected, which allows the placement of multiple Ballistas that remain permanently until the event is over. Etherian Mana cannot be used outside the event. These weapons cannot be used outside of the Old One's Army event until the event has been successfully completed.

Ballista sentries are boosted by the Squire armor and Valhalla Knight armor set bonuses, which increase the velocity of the Ballista Shot projectiles by 31.25% and allow them to pierce through maximum of six enemies, before dissipating on the seventh hit. In addition, they grant the Ballista Panic! buff for 5 seconds when the player takes damage, which increases the sentries' fire rate. The Valhalla Knight armor also greatly increases the fire rate.
Their best modifier is Fabled. However, if the player's summon damage bonuses reach 57.5% (including whip bonuses), the Ballista Staff's best modifier becomes Ruthless.
Balloon Animal: The Balloon Animal is a vanity accessory purchased from the Clothier for 2 Gold while a Party is active. When worn, the Balloon Animal will be shown being held by the player, bobbing up and down.
The Balloon Animal cannot be reforged, and therefore cannot have modifiers.
Balloon Pufferfish: The Balloon Pufferfish is an accessory that has identical function to the Shiny Red Balloon. It increases the player's jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the height that the player can jump from 6 tiles to ~10½ tiles, effectively a ~75% boost; however, it reduces jump height when underwater, from 8 tiles to 7 tiles. It can be obtained via fishing in any biome.
Bamboo: Bamboo is a placeable block obtained by harvesting Bamboo stalks, which generate naturally in the Jungle biome, with any pickaxe or drill. It can also be found in Jungle and Bramble Crates. Bamboo can be used to craft themed furniture, blocks, and walls.

Bamboo stalks grow above surface on Jungle grass submerged in shallow (more than 1 and no more than 5 tiles deep) water or Shimmer. Like most plants, they will not grow in front of a wall (including Glass Walls and fences). Unlike most other plants, however, Bamboo stalks grow over time and tend to grow in very long intervals.
Bamboo Leaf: The Bamboo Leaf is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Red Panda to follow the player. When the player is far enough away or in midair, the Baby Red Panda will fly towards them while surfing on a bamboo leaf to catch up to them. The Bamboo Leaf can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 75 Gold.
Bamboo Wall: Bamboo Wall is a type of wall. As with most crafted walls, Bamboo Walls are compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.
Banana: The Banana is a food and fruit item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed. This lasts for 5 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon.
It has a small chance of dropping when shaking a regular, Corrupt, Crimson, or Hallowed Palm tree in the Ocean biome.
Banana Split: The Banana Split is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed. This lasts for 10 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon. The Banana Split has a 1/50 (2%) chance of being dropped by Antlions, Antlion Chargers, and Antlion Swarmers.
Bananarang: The Bananarang is a Hardmode boomerang that is dropped by the Clown during Blood Moon with a 1/10 (10%) chance. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not have to return to the player before being fired, with a maximum of ten Bananarangs that can be thrown out at one time.
Its best modifier is Godly or Demonic. Both modifiers increase the average damage output by the same amount.
Band of Regeneration: The Band of Regeneration is an accessory that can be found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers and in Living Mahogany Trees in the Underground Jungle. When equipped, it regenerates 1 health every second. This effect stacks with the player's natural health regeneration, but unlike the natural regeneration, does not slow or stop when the player is moving or being attacked.
Band of Starpower: The Band of Starpower is an accessory that increases the player's maximum mana by 40. The Band of Starpower has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in The Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption. It can furthermore be crafted.
Banners (decorative): Banners are decorative furniture items that can be placed on the underside of blocks. Many are found naturally-placed in various biomes. There are also (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) four / (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) six crafted banners (Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) Pink, White) using Silk. Banners can be hung off of blocks and off of platforms which are in (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) any position / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) their bottom position (after being struck three times with a hammer).

Faction flags are banners found in the Dungeon. In post-Plantera worlds, the faction flags found hanging in a particular Dungeon area correspond to the background wall type (brick, slab, or tile), both of which signify the types of enemies that will spawn there. See Hardmode Dungeon for more info.
There are a total of 25 decorative banners: 6 crafted, 6 faction flags, 3 Floating Island, 6 Underworld, 3 Pyramid, and 1 dropped from the Dark Mage during the Old One's Army event.
Barnacle Staff: The Barnacle Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that can be obtained rarely by fishing in the Hardmode Jungle biome in any layer. It summons the Barnacle sentry that floats in midair, suspended from balloons, and fires poison spit at enemies, which inflicts the Poisoned debuff for 5–10 seconds.

After being summoned, the Barnacle is carried upwards by its balloons until it is at least 15 tiles above the ground directly underneath it. Coming in contact with solid blocks causes the balloons to pop and the Barnacle to attach itself to the underside of the blocks.
It is the Jungle counterpart to the Crimson's Bladetongue, the Hallow's Crystal Serpent, and the Corruption's Toxikarp, although Barnacle Staff is 33.33% more common in comparison to them.
Barrel: The Barrel is a storage item with 40 storage slots. It is functionally identical to Chests.
Barrel Launcher: The Barrel Launcher is a Hardmode ranged weapon that fires multi-colored Barrels without consuming any ammunition. The Barrels are heavily affected by gravity, bounce off blocks, and explode upon contact with an enemy or after 3 seconds have passed. After bouncing for the first time, the barrels gain a glowing effect and their damage increases to 133% of the weapon's damage (133 base damage). Bouncing again does not increase the damage further.

The Barrel Launcher has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance to be dropped by regular pirates (except Parrots) during the Pirate Invasion event. It has an increased 1/50 (2%) chance to be dropped from Pirate Captains, and a higher 1/10 (10%) chance to be dropped by the Flying Dutchman.
Basilisk: The Basilisk is a Hardmode enemy found in the Underground Desert biome. The Basilisk attacks by charging quickly towards the player while being highly resistant to knockback. It drops 1 to 3 Sturdy Fossils and has a rare chance to drop the Ancient Horn, which summons a mount version of the Basilisk.
Bass: Bass are a type of fish which are found plentifully by fishing in any biome that is not the Ocean or Desert in any layer.
Bast Statue: The Bast Statue is a furniture item that grants The Bast Defense buff to players in its vicinity, increasing their defense by 5. The buff effect can be toggled via wire. The Bast Statue can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis. It can also be found as a furniture in Underground Desert Cabins.
The buff is applied to any players standing within a rectangular area of 170×125 tiles centered on the Bast Statue, similar to Heart Lanterns and Campfires.
Bat Bat: The Bat Bat is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/300 (0.33%) chance of being dropped by any type of bat. When swung, it restores 1 health to the user upon hitting an enemy.
On The Constant seed, the drop chance is increased to a 1/100 (1%) chance.
Bat Hook: The Bat Hook is a rare pre-Hardmode grappling hook that fires a single hook which reaches 31.25 tiles at maximum length, and has the longest reach of all pre-Hardmode hooks. The Bat Hook has a 149/22500 (0.66%) chance of being obtained from Goodie Bags.

The Bat Hook has a pull-in speed of 72 mph and a hook velocity of 13.5, which makes it a very fast hook that can be acquired in the early game. However, some players may find a multi-hook (such as the Ivy Whip) preferable.
The Bat Hook can be found in naturally-generated chests in the Vampirism secret world seed.
Bat Scepter: The Bat Scepter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave. When used, it fires a burst of 2–3 homing bats, which do not pierce enemies or pass through blocks.
Bathtubs: Bathtubs are furniture items which fulfills a house's table requirement.
There is a total of (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 65 / (Old-gen console version) 16 / (3DS version) 11 Bathtub types, all being functionally identical but presenting different appearances.
Battle Potion: The Battle Potion is a buff potion which grants the Battle buff when consumed. The buff increases the spawn rate and maximum number of enemies and critters that can be on-screen at once by 100%, effectively doubling these rates. This lasts for 7 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon, by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff, or by double-tapping the buff icon.
Beach Ball: The Beach Ball is a novelty item that can be purchased from the Party Girl for 20 Copper. Using it creates an interactive beach ball for players to bounce around.
